title: Putin’s Ukraine invasion has made Russia China’s junior partner
gist: Zahar Hryniv argues China's refusal to back the Power of Siberia-2 pipeline (50 bcm/yr) at the August 31 SCO summit, demanding near-subsidized Russian domestic gas prices, shows the Ukraine invasion has made Russia China's junior partner. China has ample gas alternatives (including resumed US LNG) while Russia, losing Europe permanently, has none; China has also overtaken Russia as Central Asia's largest direct investor.
